meta.name: email-render-builder
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build the email HTML", "make this email responsive", "fix dark-mode rendering", or "QA the email across clients"; produces the coded HTML build — a responsive table layout, dark-mode + accessibility pass, a client-render matrix, image-block fallbacks, and a plain-text parity check. Not for writing the copy — use email-creative-builder; not for scoring the email or computing EQS — use email-quality-auditor. 邮件HTML/响应式邮件/暗色模式渲染

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建响应式邮件HTML，兼容各客户端与暗色模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作兼容多客户端的响应式邮件HTML
copy.tagline_en: Build responsive email HTML compatible across clients and dark mode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create responsive email HTML that works across multiple clients

howto.what: 将邮件创意或HTML代码转换为可直接发送的HTML文件，包含响应式表格布局、暗色模式适配、无障碍检查、各邮件客户端渲染结果预测、图片关闭时的替代方案、纯文本版本一致性检查。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建邮件HTML”、“让邮件适配移动端”、“修复暗色模式渲染”或“跨客户端QA邮件”时触发。需要已有文案，不负责撰写内容。

say.text: 帮我根据这段文案生成响应式邮件HTML，目标客户端是Gmail和Outlook。
say.note: 技能会生成一个单列表格布局的HTML文件。

say.text: 检查这个邮件HTML在暗色模式下的显示效果，并修复问题。
say.note: 技能会检查颜色对比度并调整，确保暗色模式可读。

say.text: 为这个邮件添加图片关闭时的替代方案，并确保按钮是防弹按钮。

howto.what_en: Converts email creative or raw HTML into a coded HTML build with responsive table layout, dark-mode pass, accessibility pass, client-render matrix, image-off fallbacks, and plain-text parity check.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build the email HTML", "make this email responsive", "fix dark-mode rendering", or "QA the email across clients". Requires existing copy; does not write content.

say_en.text: Generate responsive email HTML from this copy, targeting Gmail and Outlook.
say_en.note: The skill produces a single-column table-based HTML file.

say_en.text: Check this email HTML for dark-mode rendering issues and fix them.
say_en.note: The skill checks color contrast and adjusts for dark mode readability.

say_en.text: Add image-off fallbacks and make all CTAs bulletproof for this email.
say_en.note: The skill adds alt text to images and converts CTA buttons to HTML/CSS only.
